seller_or_subject: @mikepsilva — raising Patreon/Discord tier prices due to overhead costs
what: Creator announces raising Patreon/Discord pricing from current $9/month because overhead costs are "getting out of hand," especially after introducing an AI bot. Offers existing patrons a grandfathering window.
verbatim_snippet: "If you want to be grandfathered in on my Patreon/discord pricing of $9/month (little less if you buy the year upfront), Do it before this month ends as prices are going up. It will still be very affordable, but the overhead costs to run the it are getting out of hand. Especially since I introduced my Asher Bot."
notes: 3,365 views, 47 reposts. Timing aligns with Patreon's 10% fee increase announcement (August 2025). Creator uses hybrid Patreon+Discord strategy.
